company.shortDescription: Dojah is an AI powered fraud prevention and KYC Platform to identity for growth, security, and compliance in the businesses.
company.description: Dojah is a global fraud prevention and KYC platform trusted by businesses of all sizes to verify identify, beat fraud, stay compliant, and onboard customers safely. With a global presence and support for over 150 countries, Dojah helps businesses protect themselves from fraud and comply with regulations, no matter where they operate.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $788,268 to $11,297,369, a 14.33x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 44 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 63 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
